options.title: Walk
steps: Open pedestrian directions from Galata Tower to Sultanahmet Square. Exact walking distance and duration are not yet calculated.

options.title: Walk + T1
steps: Walk from Galata Tower to Karaköy tram stop. Check the pedestrian route on the map.
Board T1 toward Bağcılar. Continue through Eminönü, Sirkeci and Gülhane.
Get off at Sultanahmet and walk to Sultanahmet Square.

options.title: F1 + T1
steps: Enter the F1 funicular at Taksim and ride to Kabataş.
At Kabataş, transfer to T1 toward Bağcılar. This is a separate boarding; fare rules must be checked.
Get off at Sultanahmet and walk to Sultanahmet Square.

options.title: Walk
steps: Open pedestrian directions from Sultanahmet Square to the Grand Bazaar. Check your intended entrance and opening hours separately.

options.title: Walk + T1
steps: Walk to Sultanahmet tram stop.
Take T1 toward Bağcılar, passing Çemberlitaş.
Get off at Beyazıt-Kapalıçarşı and walk to the Grand Bazaar entrance.

options.title: Şehir Hatları ferry
steps: Go to the Şehir Hatları piers at Eminönü. Find a departure serving Kadıköy.
Check the departure time, intermediate calls and ticket fare on the operator's timetable before boarding.
Travel to Kadıköy and leave the ferry at Kadıköy pier.
options.mapDestination: Eminonu Sehir Hatlari Kadikoy Pier, Istanbul

options.title: Şehir Hatları ferry
steps: Go to the Şehir Hatları piers at Eminönü. Find a departure serving Üsküdar.
Check the Üsküdar–Karaköy–Eminönü line's timetable for the correct direction and departure before boarding.
Leave the ferry at Üsküdar pier.
options.mapDestination: Eminonu Sehir Hatlari Uskudar Pier, Istanbul

options.title: M4 metro
steps: Follow airport signs to the M4 Sabiha Gökçen Havalimanı metro station.
Board M4 toward Kadıköy. Stay on the train to Kadıköy; no line change is needed for this itinerary.
Get off at Kadıköy and follow signs to your intended exit.
